design: Tall muscular custodian with a low broad cranium, rugged cheek lobes and a dense backward fan of silver-tipped tendrils. Three-tier heavy plum shoulder mantle over a long sleeveless charcoal-purple robe, broad bronze-plate belt and two wide hem panels. Both hands present a shallow empty bronze ceremonial bowl level at the waist. Deep charcoal mottled hide, calm grounded posture.
